title: Juicy Fermented Free Range Low Sodium Egg Stir-fry
description: A kid-friendly Russian dish featuring fermented egg, free-range eggs beaten, and a touch of herbs for a savory twist with a low-sodium kick.

ingredients.name: Fermented Egg
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality fermented egg for best results.

ingredients.name: Water Chestnuts
ingredients.notes: Soaked and rinsed to remove any bitterness.

ingredients.name: Bean Sprouts
ingredients.notes: Rinsed to remove any dirt or impurities.

instructions: Heat a wok or non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add beaten free-range eggs and stir quickly until they set into small curds.
Fold in water chestnuts, shredded cabbage, green onions (scallions), bean sprouts, and chopped herbs.
Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until vegetables are slightly tender but still crisp.
Sprinkle fermented egg over the stir-fried vegetables, ensuring they're evenly distributed.
Continue to cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, allowing the fermented egg to meld with other ingredients without breaking into pieces.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot as a side dish or on its own.

axes.descriptor: Juicy Fermented Free Range Low Sodium
